text: Managers of funds that exist only as smart contracts in cyberspace, with no foreign or domestic domicile, cannot assume they are judgment proof; the more likely outcome is that they must comply with more regulations, not fewer, because every node location can trigger a jurisdiction.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: However, managers cannot assume that they are judgment-proof. Instead, fund managers may be required to comply with more regulations not fewer.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to funds constituted entirely through smart contracts on a public blockchain such as Ethereum
